name: av_stock_monthly
description:
Monthly OHLCV price history for one stock from Alpha Vantage (TIME_SERIES_MONTHLY), covering 20+ years.
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Monthly Time Series"} keyed by month-end date, each with "1. open" to "5. volume".
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker).
Finer bars: av_stock_weekly, av_stock_daily.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}
